avis.texte: I discovered Elemis products on a cruise. I love the feeling of this serum as the first step in my moisturing routine. It leaves my skin feeling smooth & hydrated. Well worth the money.

Pretty pricey item, but after reading the reviews I was intrigued enough to give it a try. I'm on my second bottle now and have been using it consistently day and night, and I love what it is doing for my skin. The smell and texture are amazing, and I absolutely love the soft, almost glass-like feel it gives my face. I've noticed improvement in the fine lines on my forehead and the slight redness around my mouth and chin. I am a believer and will continue using this product! For reference, I'm 41 with normal-to-dry skin and live in a dry climate.

I bought this serum after being in a group of girls talking about different products that they are using. I went into the Ulta store to ask for the best product they had and this is the product that they recommended I highly recommend it to anyone that I talk to, the results I have seen are amazing. I have recommended this to my family which are now using it as well. I highly recommend it to anyone that is needing a good face serum.

Love the rep from Elemis Veronica Lazzarinetti for all her knowledge with skin care and this product. She was wonderful and now has a long-time client. Please let her know how much I appreciate her help and knowledge.

avis.texte: This gem is packed with some skin loving ingredients (a few I would have , but that's okay) It's gentle, but powerful at the same time! You have the collagen your skin NEEDS! Then you you get the perks of removing dead skin cells that clog up your beautiful face/neck! Tips, put a few drops in your hands and PRESS into your skin (especially those stubborn places that you would love to see improvement) Then you can take a little and dab in the rest of your face and neck. Pressing this skin loving oil in REALLY makes it one with your skin. Cons, you don't get much AT ALL for the price! They have used some fantastic ingredients and after doing research on their labs and where they get their ingredients, definitely an expensive mixture for them to mix and they have to make profit. However they could cut a few corners by changing up the packaging. Although squeeze tubes aren't as pretty and they would have to make one that doesn't leak as this is THIN oil. That alone could save and allow for some price difference. In the end…it's a beautiful formula that truly helps your skin! Wrinkles can reduce. Your skin can plump, you'll notice a difference with weeks of use (nothing great happens quickly; never forget that!) So if you can find it in your budget, I HIGHLY recommend trying this baby out.
